## IMPULSE 0.5.0

This release adds a proper launch-to-menu flow and makes saved campaign progression easier to resume without changing the core one-tap gameplay.

### Highlights

- New main menu with Continue, New game, Achievements, About, and Exit actions.
- Continue opens the highest unlocked level.
- New game starts from level 1 without deleting saved progress, scores, stars, or settings.
- Achievements summarizes the highest unlocked level and total earned stars.
- The branded IMPULSE splash now remains on screen for five seconds before opening the menu.
- Android back navigation returns from gameplay and menu subscreens to the main menu.
- Expanded Android runtime coverage validates the new splash/menu/navigation flow on API 37.
- Repository-wide cleanup reduced unused dependencies, resources, build configuration, and avoidable runtime work without changing gameplay behavior.
- Qodana analysis remains available on the current AGP 9.3.2 toolchain through the JVM Community linter configuration.

IMPULSE remains fully offline with no account, analytics, ads, backend, cloud sync, or Android `INTERNET` permission.

Release artifacts are signed with the existing project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
